entries.partTitle: Distributed State Machines: AWS Step Functions & Saga Pattern Orchestration

left.title: Two-Phase Commit
items: Synchronous row locks degrade availability.
Single database outage blocks all participants.
Fails to scale across cloud microservices.

right.title: Saga Orchestrator
items: Coordinates independent local transactions in sequence.
Zero distributed row locking between databases.
Compensating actions undo state upon failure.

entries.partTitle: Task Integrations: Optimized Service Calls & Asynchronous Task Tokens

left.title: Polling Activities
items: Continuous status polling consumes compute cycles.
Increases idle cloud infrastructure expenses.
Brittle worker timeouts during long pauses.

right.title: Task Token Callback
items: Pauses execution durably with cryptographic token.
Incurs zero compute charges during waiting periods.
External systems resume workflow via success API.

entries.partTitle: High-Concurrency Workflows: Parallel State Branching & Distributed Map Processing

left.title: Sequential Looping
items: Sequential iteration multiplies processing duration.
Limited to inline memory payloads under load.
Database overload without concurrency throttles.

right.title: Distributed Map
items: Scales up to ten thousand parallel child workflows.
Streams millions of records directly from storage.
MaxConcurrency throttles protect downstream databases.

entries.partTitle: Resilient Error Handling: Retries, Catch Blocks & Compensating Rollbacks

left.title: Uncaught Failures
items: Partial execution leaves orphaned database rows.
Lack of retry backoff overwhelms failing APIs.
Manual database surgery required after outages.

right.title: Compensating Rollback
items: Exponential backoff retries resolve transient glitches.
Catch blocks trigger reverse compensating actions.
Idempotent rollbacks ensure consistent final state.

entries.partTitle: Enterprise Saga Synthesis: End-to-End Orchestration & Verification Token

left.title: Custom Glue Code
items: Hardcoded orchestration logic inside microservices.
Lacks visual debugging and state auditability.
Complex error handling duplicated across codebases.

right.title: Synthesized Saga
items: Declarative state machine coordinates full lifecycle.
Native visual tracing and error diagnosis in console.
Emits cryptographic confirmation token upon test.
